title: DigitalOcean Shares Fall 3.1% Premarket After Beating Q3 Estimates
summary:
The cloud infrastructure provider posted adjusted earnings per share of $0.45 and revenue of $321M for the third quarter, surpassing the $0.32 and $307M targets projected by analysts. Despite the beat and a revised fiscal 2026 revenue target of up to $1.211B, DigitalOcean saw its shares decline 3.1% in premarket trading on Monday.

The company credited the expansion of its artificial intelligence tools for the growth, reporting that annual recurring revenue from AI customers rose 288% year over year to $376M. To maintain the trajectory, the firm announced it had secured a $785M equipment lease facility and expanded its committed data center capacity to roughly 180 MW.
